question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’. __We are waiting __for the minister for the last two hours.
solution:
The solution is **We have been waiting.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in "* **We are waiting __**for the minister for the last two hours.*" is We have been waiting.
 
• __We are waiting __for the minister for the last two hours.
 
• Here the tense of underlined word is incorrect.
 
• The given sentence tense is **Present continuous tense.**
 
• The tense of the sentence should be **Present perfect continuous tense**.
 __
 
• **Present continuous tense - **It is a present continuous tense when the verb form used for action or event that are happening or developing now in present.
 
• **Present perfect continuous tense -** It is a present perfect continuous tense when starting in the past and occurring until now with an adverb modifier that indicates the approximate duration or an action occurring until lately or recently with some relevant effect continuing into the present.
 
 
 
• Therefore **option 1 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
